laws: Preserve the caller's immutable image; no publication or default image is invented.
The HTTP provider port, PORT environment and required canonical HTTPS upstream agree.
Changed product material has a distinct identity; equal inputs yield canonical equal values.
No protected health, native verification, secret delivery or runtime authority delivery is declared for the website.
Selected connector document content and value agree; wrong product or ambiguous ingress target refuses.
The graph is ordinary, nonmanaged, roundtrippable and scoped only to the explicit frontend workspace/runtime.
Separate workspace lifetime preserves the website during Hello teardown; live inventory disjointness remains the run plan's obligation.
negative_cases: Credential/path/query-bearing or noncanonical origins; invalid port or unpinned image; mismatched connector document; wrong ingress socket; aliased website/connector; untyped authority.
discarded_assumptions: No root bootstrap extension, fictitious SDK receiver, temporary probe, or source-test claim of live readiness/retention.
evidence: Existing DockerInstallationTests informs pure product/reference composition. No migration or frozen-suite translation; unchanged owning Docker ./test.sh supplies target-red and green.
